bullets.text: Apple's March Event Approaches - New MacBooks and iPhones expected at the March 4 event, featuring high-performance Apple silicon.
Apple's Unique Launch Format - Rumours suggest multiple days of press releases instead of a traditional keynote for product announcements.
Audible's New Feature - 'Read & Listen' syncs e-books with audiobooks, enhancing the reading experience for users.
iPadOS 26.4 Beta Released - Public beta now available, introducing new features for iPad users.
iOS 26.4 Enhancements - New features include CarPlay video support and Playlist Playground for Apple Music.
OpenAI Expands in India - Partnering with Tata to secure AI data center capacity, enhancing local infrastructure.
Meta's Smartwatch Plans - Meta aims to launch a smartwatch with health tracking features later this year.
Snapchat+ Subscriber Growth - Surpassing 25 million subscribers, driving Snap's annual revenue to $1 billion.
Google Unveils Pixel 10a - New entry-level smartphone features AI capabilities and improved battery life.
Amazon Halts Robotics Project - Blue Jay robotics initiative discontinued after less than six months.
